s17-implement-trie-insert-search-startsw.trick: Each edge represents one lowercase letter. A terminal flag distinguishes a complete word from its prefixes.

s17-implement-trie-2-prefix-tree.trick: Count how many words pass through each node and how many end there; decrement both counts when erasing an existing word.

s17-longest-string-with-all-prefixes.trick: After inserting every word, a word qualifies only if every node along its path ends a word. Prefer longer words, then lexicographically smaller ones.

s17-number-of-distinct-substrings-in-a-s.trick: Insert every suffix into a trie. Every newly created node corresponds to one distinct nonempty substring.

s17-bit-prerequisites-for-trie-problems.trick: Read, set, clear, and flip a bit with shifts and masks; XOR is one exactly when bits differ.

s17-maximum-xor-of-two-numbers-in-an-arr.trick: Insert numbers into a bit trie. For each bit, try the opposite branch to maximize XOR.

s17-maximum-xor-with-an-element-from-arr.trick: Sort values and offline queries by maximum allowed value. Insert eligible numbers into a bit trie before answering each query.
s17-maximum-xor-with-an-element-from-arr.time: O(n log n + q log q + 32(n+q))
